new.n: Old Camps, sec. 11 T52N R35W (1911 plat)
new.pl: W sec. 11 T52N R35W, by the W quarter line where the Trail crosses the creek, Houghton County
new.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (T52N R35W page) marks "Old Camps" in the west part of sec. 11, by the west quarter line on the creek where the Trail crosses. The H.C.&S.W. railway survey line runs across secs. 11-12. The camps were already abandoned by 1911.
new.t: Look for the camp clearing, stove parts, bottles and horseshoes. Ask the landowner or the forest office first.
src: Plat book of Houghton County, Michigan (Weston & Hancock, c1911), T52N R35W page (scan 45) (Neb's screenshot)
pinev: Placed by the W quarter corner of sec. 11; good to about 300 m

new.pl: sec. 21/22 line T52N R36W, near Wyandotte, Houghton County
new.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (T52N R36W page) marks the Wyandotte Mine at the sec. 21/22 line. GNIS keeps the place name Wyandotte about 500 m west, in SW NE sec. 21, near Wyandotte Falls. Keweenaw poor-rock piles are where native copper, silver and datolite turn up.
new.t: Old mine ground about 560 m from Twin Lakes State Park: check the land is not park ground (Michigan state parks need a permit to detect), stay off shafts and adits, and ask the landowner first. Poor-rock piles are the place to look.
src: Plat book of Houghton County, Michigan (Weston & Hancock, c1911), T52N R36W page (scan 64) (Neb's screenshot)
pinev: Placed on the sec. 21/22 line at the GNIS Wyandotte latitude; good to about 300 m

new.n: Halfway House on the Misery Bay Road (1911 plat)
new.pl: SE SW sec. 11 T52N R36W, by the 11/14 line, Houghton County
new.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (T52N R36W page) marks the Halfway House where the Misery Bay Road meets the road north from Twin Lakes, in SE SW sec. 11 by the 11/14 line. It was a stopping place for teams and travellers on the road to Misery Bay.
new.t: Roadhouse ground: look for the building and barn pads at the road corner, the well, and the dump behind it. Ask the landowner first.
